before_after_rationale.why_this_reduces_time_to_root: It restores missing parallel capacity and proof-denominator coverage without shrinking scope, modifying prompts/schedules, or touching protected O authority.

rollback.condition: If a re-enabled role produces durable evidence of a concrete unrepaired terminal Chat-mode fault, preserve the evidence and repair that exact cause through repository control. Never roll back by disabling it as optimization, shrinking the denominator, restoring unrelated base work, exceeding capacity, or changing protected O authority.
